testcase.name: Scenario: Adjust the inactive opacity of the orientation control: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:111:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Adjust the inactive opacity of the orientation control ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control has 50 percent inactive opacity ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options and expands the inactive opacity list ✔ Then the list offers 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent ✔ When the user chooses 100 percent and confirms the options ✔ And the user moves the pointer away from the orientation control ✔ Then the inactive control appears more opaque than at 50 percent ✔ And the part remains in its existing view ✔ When the user reopens the options, chooses 50 percent and confirms ✔ And the user moves the pointer away from the control ✔ Then the control returns to its earlier translucent appearance ✔ And the same part remains active
